# FormFlowX

> FormFlowX is a free online form builder — a lightweight alternative to Typeform, Jotform, and Google Forms for individuals, startups, and small teams who want conversational forms with built-in logic and analytics, without paying per response.

FormFlowX lets anyone build beautiful multi-step forms in minutes with no code. Unlike Google Forms, it supports conditional logic, drop-off analytics, partial submission capture, and custom themes. Unlike Typeform, the free plan includes 100 responses per month with no branding restrictions, and paid plans start at $15/month — not $25+.

Every form is self-hosted on FormFlowX's infrastructure. Responses are stored securely in a managed database, viewable in a real-time dashboard, and exportable to CSV. No Google account required. No data leaves the platform without the form owner's control.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://formflowx.com/): Free online form builder — create, share, and analyze forms in minutes
- [Features](https://formflowx.com/features): Full feature overview including conditional logic, analytics, and integrations
- [Pricing](https://formflowx.com/pricing): Free (100 responses/month), Pro ($15/month), Business ($39/month)
- [Templates](https://formflowx.com/templates): Pre-built form templates for contact forms, lead capture, surveys, job applications, and more
- [Integrations](https://formflowx.com/integrations): Slack, webhooks, Zapier, email notifications, and more

## Key Features

- **Conversational forms**: One question at a time — higher completion rates than traditional forms
- **Conditional logic**: Show or hide fields based on answers, with no code required
- **Partial submission capture**: Recover leads and data from respondents who start but don't finish
- **Drop-off analytics**: See exactly which question loses respondents and fix it with data
- **Multi-step forms**: Break long forms into sections to reduce overwhelm
- **Custom themes**: Brand colours, fonts, and backgrounds
- **Free forever plan**: 100 responses/month, no credit card required
- **Embed anywhere**: Drop a single script tag into any website — Next.js, Webflow, plain HTML

## About

FormFlowX is an independent SaaS product. It is not affiliated with Google, Typeform, Jotform, or any other form builder. The free plan is genuinely free — no credit card, no trial expiry, 100 responses per month indefinitely.
